text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (It was so hot back then too.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Reeeeally? Whyyy is it sooo hot out?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'm done! I don't wanna walk
another
step!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It only feels that way because
your
room is freezing cold.
...Here,
Sweepy. Put out your hand.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Refresh shower!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! That smells so nice! What was
that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I just gave you a spritz of magic
spray!
...Is the smell the only thing that
you've noticed?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Grandma, my hands feel cool!
They're not
hot at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Heeheehee. Right? I expect they'll cool
down
even more and feel even better as
you walk!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Really?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You were totally right! They're so cold!
Ahaha! I
wonder how they'll feel if I run!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ Your spells are always so
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Grandma! Is racing magic even
more
amazing than your magic just now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course! Now, my best spell is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Look, Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Really soon, I just know I'm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a break during summer camp, Sweep
Tosho
wakes up from a nap she was
taking under a tree.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah, duh! I don't have time to waste!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Sweep Tosho! The magical girl
racer!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! You were so cool in the
Japanese
Oaks! ☆ Good luck in the
Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I bet no matter who you ask,
everyone
would say you're the one to
look out for! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Keep your eyes on me and
I'll cast my
racing magic on you too!

text_block_list.name: Women
text_block_list.text: Oooh! You're adooorable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, after training, I'm relaxing at the
campsite,
when...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, Familiar! Perfect timing! Say "ah"!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean "why"?! Your master
gave you
an order, now open your
mouth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho lays down the law with no
room for
negotiation. The pressure is
intense. I...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heeey! What are you doing?! Familiar!
choice_data_list: これは怖い！力いっぱい抵抗する

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Don't be such a whiny little baby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho grabs me forcefully by the
cheek
and pulls me toward her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! You're an adult, aren't you?
Behave!
...Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My mouth floods with the sweet taste of
honey.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's Grandma's super special candy. It's
enchanted
with the power to cheer you
right up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's been so hot lately. I don't want you
passing
out on me, so I figured I'd give
you some.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph!
choice_data_list: ……気を使ってくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's the only one you're getting. I've
only got
two left!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The candy she gave me is sweeter than
any I've
ever had before. I can feel the
sugar spreading
through me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! There's a good familiar! ...Here
you go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eeeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The overpowering taste of raw
vegetables fills my
mouth. It's likely
something fresh from the
ground,
seasoned only by Mother Nature...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Grandma always says mugwort is
the queen
of herbs.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's been so hot recently, you gotta
make sure
you're getting all your
nutrition!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magical girl's job to take care of
her
familiars! Duh!
choice_data_list: 気遣ってくれたんだね……！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Guess I might as well have some too...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's with you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What? Are you trying to keep all the
mugwort for
yourself or something?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not happening! I can't afford to pass out
over
here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I get it. Mugwort really is just the
best, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy when Grandma gave me
some for
the first time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp!
choice_data_list: それは恐らく調理済みだからで――

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah! That's bitter!
